journey.name: Pricing Offers
journey.description: Validates that an administrator can review pricing offers such as Founding Merchants, see their slots, window, price overrides and perks, pause, resume or end an offer after confirming, and track the setup call and review commitments of the stores that redeemed it.

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard, open '/dashboard/billing/plans' and click 'Pricing offers'.
Verify each offer shows its status badge, redemptions against the cap, slots left and window, and that the first offer is selected below.
Verify the detail shows trial days, eligible plans, price overrides (with 'locked for life') and perks.
Click 'Pause' and verify a dialog says existing redemptions keep their trial and locked price; confirm and verify the status becomes Paused.
Click 'Resume', confirm, then 'End'; verify the dialog says it cannot be reopened, confirm, and verify the status becomes Ended with no lifecycle buttons left.
In Redemptions, tick 'Setup call' for a store, then add a note and click 'Save'; verify both persist after reload.
